first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A person with auburn hair styled in a low bun, bare shoulders, and wrapped in a white bath towel; in the later segment, both the direct image and the mirror reflection appear simultaneously.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: A person with long, dark, curly hair, wearing a bright red sleeveless V-neck outfit, positioned in front of the doorway at the beginning of the clip.

entities.name: large wall mirror
entities.identification: A large rectangular mirror surface on the wall, reflecting Person A and the pink background.

entities.name: dark brick wall
entities.identification: The source ID covers the narrow dark brick edge to the right of the doorway at the beginning of the clip, as well as the dark green square-tiled areas beside and below the mirror in the later segment.

entities.name: pink wall
entities.identification: A large expanse of pink wall in the bathroom, with a fine surface texture discernible at the beginning of the clip.

entities.name: doorway and back room
entities.identification: A doorway with light-colored trim, the adjacent blue area, and the purplish-gray interior and small warm-colored light visible behind the doorway.

entities.name: dark counter area along the wall
entities.identification: The dark counter area extending along the wall at the lower right in the later segment, with blue-and-white bottles and jars and a blue-rimmed oval small mirror.

entities.name: wall shelf for folded towels
entities.identification: A narrow blue wall shelf partially visible at the left edge at the beginning of the clip, with light-colored, pink, and yellow towel-like fabrics folded and stacked on top.
